title: Have ADHD? Get this app!
body:
I got this app prior to being officially diagnosed with ADHD earlier this year as it would help me stay focused. Now that I officially have the ADHD diagnosis I use it even more, especially when I have big tasks that need my attention. 

I’ve tried some competitors, but keep coming back to FocusBrain.

I like how the iPhone app can be used on MacOS even though not officially supported. It works on MacOS majority of the time, but occasionally there are weird quirks that pop up that I wish were fixed so I wouldn’t have to use my iPhone (it’s a distraction)!
